name: Digital Hygiene
description: Cleans and optimizes your digital life: unsubscribes from junk, purges old emails, tracks subscriptions, recovers refunds, and manages gift cards.

team.description: Cleans and optimizes your digital life: unsubscribes from junk, purges old emails, tracks subscriptions, recovers refunds, and manages gift cards.

members.role: Deep clean — organizes Drive, archives old files, removes duplicates
Mail optimization — categorizes, archives, and sets up filters
Bulk purge — identifies and removes years of accumulated email clutter
Unsubscribe automation — identifies and unsubscribes from marketing lists
Subscription audit — identifies unused subscriptions and guides cancellation
Refund recovery — finds price drops and eligibility for refunds
Gift card & returns — tracks balances, return windows, and pending refunds

sharedContext.description: Cleanup context: all digital hygiene tasks share a unified view of what needs attention.
